## Objective
Fix the specimen contradiction: run RON-160-20260705T031413Z-d846d0b8 validated its final report, passed clean-eval, then still burned to max_turns and recorded BOTH 0108-completed.json and 0109-failed.json, exiting nonzero with a type error on gates_run.

## Design summary
Three bound changes (ticket fix direction, implement as specified):
1. New terminal outcome: in the run-decision path (agent_runner.ex L1407-1419 max_turns clause and the continue-decision logic feeding it), when the final report is valid, clean-eval context is green or pending-only, tracker is unavailable (manifest run), and next_state stays active solely because PR/review evidence is absent - stop with a distinct `handoff_required` outcome instead of returning continue. It is a successful, deliberate handoff state: exit zero, checkpoint payload names the missing evidence.
2. Normalize gates_run: the crash `{:agent_run_failed, "expected a map, got: <string>"}` came from final-report gates_run entries being command strings. Normalize/validate gates_run at the final-report validation boundary (string entries wrap into a map form) so post-validation consumers never see raw strings.
3. Single terminal classification: make terminal checkpoint writing exclusive - a run records completed XOR failed XOR handoff_required, never two. Guard at the checkpoint-write layer, not the call sites.
- Tests in run_decision_test.exs + agent_runner tests: valid-report/no-tracker -> handoff_required, exit 0, single terminal checkpoint; string gates_run -> normalized, no crash; genuine failure -> failed only.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/agent_runner.ex, elixir/lib/rondo/run_decision.ex, their tests. Exclude: tracker integrations, clean_eval internals (RON-162 lands separately before this).

## Constraints
Tracker-driven flows keep current behavior. No remote writes.

## Verification
cd elixir && mix test test/rondo/run_decision_test.exs
cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted && mix credo --strict && mix test
Pre-PR: cd elixir && mix dialyzer --format short

max_turns_reached dispatch at agent_runner.ex L1407-1419 and run_decision.ex helpers (checkpoint_payload L11, synthetic_update L33) verified in-session
Upstream slices ron-159-gate-repair-turn (turn-loop) and ron-162-clean-eval-executes-declared-gates (clean-eval semantics) must land first
